Run configured group inference without refitting GLMs

Source: R/fwe_pipeline.R
run_fwe_correction.Rd

Runs the declarative corrections stored in L3 models' inference fields and in gpa$fwe_correction. Scheduler runs return after submission; use refresh_fwe_correction() to collect them.

Usage

run_fwe_correction(
  gpa,
  l3_model_names = names(gpa$l3_models$models),
  force = FALSE,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

gpa

a glm_pipeline_arguments object.

l3_model_names

models whose configured corrections should run; defaults to all L3 models.

force

rerun corrections even when verified outputs exist.

dry_run

preview plans and commands without writing or submitting.

...

additional arguments to run_fwe_plan().

Value

Updated gpa, with fwe_runs and fwe_status.
